bike.name: 9.0 · MY2011
bike.claim: The aluminium Speedmax: Canyon's aero-era geometry and carbon fork on a 7005 alloy frame, at a fraction of the carbon bike's price.

hero.title: Speedmax AL
hero.lede: The aluminium Speedmax: Canyon's aero-era geometry and carbon fork on a 7005 alloy frame, at a fraction of the carbon bike's price.

geometryNote: Scale comes from circle fits to both tyres in Canyon's archived side photo. Every tube is a traced centreline with its side-view depth measured from the photo; widths across the bike are inferred. Parts are rebuilt from the archived specification.

tour.title: A silhouette from the archive
tour.text: Launched alongside the first carbon Speedmax at Eurobike 2008, the Speedmax AL carried the same adjustable-seat-angle geometry (75° or 78°) and sliding dropouts (380-395 mm chainstays) in 7005 aluminium with an AeroShape tubeset. It stayed in the range until MY2013.

tour.title: Cockpit of its era
tour.text: Clip-on extensions, cable housings and the cockpit hardware documented for this build. Side profiles are traced from the archived photograph; depths remain interpreted.

tour.title: The drivetrain, as listed
tour.text: 52 / 36 rings with a Ultegra 12–25 cassette. Switch to Ride to see cadence drive the wheels through the listed ratio.

tour.title: The other side of the story
tour.text: Brakes, hubs and frame details follow the archived specification. Where the photo is silent, shapes are inferred and marked as such.

tour.title: Exhibit 05 · Speedmax AL 9.0 · MY2011
tour.text: A photo-calibrated reconstruction. Orbit freely, repaint it in the Customizer, or light it in the Aero lab. Sources and uncertainties are listed in Specs.
